title: acalypha parvula var. genuina
intro: Acalypha parvula var. genuina, commonly known as Dwarf Copperleaf, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a shrub-like herb that has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The plant is known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents present in Acalypha parvula var. genuina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
